items.title: Skip the Antibacterial Soap; Use Plain Soap and Water
items.excerpt: There isn’t sufficient evidence to show that OTC antibacterial soaps are better at preventing illness than washing with plain soap and water. Washing your hands is easy, and it’s one of the most effective ways to prevent the spread of germs.
